sources.title: GitHub - RealRebelAI/ComfyUI_Rebels_SeFi: a custom node set to run SeFi ...
sources.snippet: Run SeFi-Image 5B (Semantic-First Diffusion, FLUX.2-Klein-based) in ComfyUI — Base and Turbo, safetensors (bf16) and GGUF — engineered to run on 8GB VRAM / 16GB RAM with automatic VRAM-aware offloading. Wraps the official MIT inference code from jmliu206/SeFi-Image (vendored in sefi_core/, credit SeFi-Team). Nodes, GGUF support, and memory management by realrebelai.
